ddl.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE 
  account_closure AS (
    -- Base case: Every account maps to itself
    SELECT
      "ledger"."accounts"."id" AS account_id,
      "ledger"."accounts"."id" AS ancestor_id,
      "ledger"."accounts"."organization_id" AS organization_id
    FROM "ledger"."accounts"

    UNION ALL

  -- Recursive step: Step up the tree using parent_id
    SELECT
      child.account_id,
      curr."parent_id" AS ancestor_id,
      child.organization_id
    FROM account_closure child
    JOIN "ledger"."accounts" curr ON curr."id" = child.ancestor_id
    WHERE curr."parent_id" IS NOT NULL
  )
, posting_periods AS ((select "ledger"."postings"."account_id", "ledger"."periods"."id" as "period_id", "ledger"."postings"."debit", "ledger"."postings"."credit", "ledger"."postings"."exchange_rate", "base_currencies"."decimals" - "core"."currencies"."decimals" as "decimals_shift" from "ledger"."postings" inner join "ledger"."journal_entries" on "ledger"."journal_entries"."id" = "ledger"."postings"."journal_entry_id" inner join "core"."currencies" on "core"."currencies"."code" = "ledger"."postings"."currency" inner join "core"."accounting_settings" on "core"."accounting_settings"."organization_id" = "ledger"."journal_entries"."organization_id" inner join "core"."currencies" "base_currencies" on "base_currencies"."code" = "core"."accounting_settings"."base_currency" inner join "ledger"."periods" on (("ledger"."periods"."organization_id" = "ledger"."journal_entries"."organization_id") and ("ledger"."journal_entries"."valid_on" between "ledger"."periods"."start_on" and "ledger"."periods"."end_on")))), account_balances_cte AS ((select "ledger"."accounts"."organization_id", "ledger"."periods"."id" as "period_id", "ledger"."accounts"."id" as "account_id", "ledger"."accounts"."parent_id", "ledger"."accounts"."code", "ledger"."accounts"."name", "ledger"."accounts"."type", (COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.debit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0))::numeric(78, 0) as "total_debit", (COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.credit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0))::numeric(78, 0) as "total_credit", (
      CASE
            WHEN "ledger"."accounts"."type" = 'asset' OR "ledger"."accounts"."type" = 'expense'
      THEN COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.debit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.credit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0)
      ELSE
      COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.credit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.debit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0)
      END
    )::numeric(78, 0) as "balance", now() as "computed_at" from "ledger"."accounts" inner join "ledger"."periods" on "ledger"."periods"."organization_id" = "ledger"."accounts"."organization_id" left join account_closure on ((account_closure.ancestor_id = "ledger"."accounts"."id") and (account_closure.organization_id = "ledger"."accounts"."organization_id")) left join posting_periods on ((posting_periods.account_id = account_closure.account_id) and (posting_periods.period_id = "ledger"."periods"."id")) group by "ledger"."accounts"."organization_id", "ledger"."accounts"."id", "ledger"."accounts"."parent_id", "ledger"."accounts"."code", "ledger"."accounts"."name", "ledger"."accounts"."type", "ledger"."periods"."id" having COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.debit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0) != 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(posting_periods.credit * posting_periods.exchange_rate * power(10::numeric, posting_periods.decimals_shift))), 0) != 0))
  SELECT * FROM account_balances_cte
